ClinicCreate.description:

the business in the same step: it is named ``client_organization_name``, or the clinic's name.

created); an existing clinic-member login is linked to this clinic.

the Platform Administrator and the clinic's DSM only.

* ``practitioner``: the shared record (the practitioner himself, the DSM, the admin; name and
  registration number: DSM / admin only; NOT a Clinic Administrator)
* ``clinic_practitioner``: this clinic's details (admin, DSM, Clinic Administrator; NOT the
  practitioner)
